comment: Pipeline entries the macOS preview runs, read by the agent (host.macos) and by the client before submitting tasks. entries: verified on a real Mac (add only after a device run). experimental: available on macOS but not yet verified there, marked as such where tasks are picked and when they start. excluded: entries that cannot work or are known to misbehave on macOS, with the reason shown to the user. Any entry in none of the lists is refused. notes: shown to Mac users next to the task (the client only; the agent ignores them): a hint for verified entries, a visible line for experimental ones. docs/macos-support-plan.md has the per-task table.
